rules: Snap yardline_100 <= 20 / 10 / 5. Carries: rush attempts with a rusher, including scrambles; kneel-downs excluded. Targets: non-sack pass attempts with an intended receiver, caught or not. Two-point tries and plays erased by accepted penalties excluded. TDs count only on plays snapped in the zone; lateral TDs excluded.
